questions.stem: Alternative medication for secondary prevention of acute rheumatic fever in penicillin-allergic patients is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Erythromycin

Erythromycin is an antibiotic used for the treatment of a number of bacterial infections. This includes respiratory tract infections, skin infections, chlamydia infections, pelvic inflammatory disease, and syphilis.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 769, 803

questions.stem: Which of the following drugs is not used in typhoid?
questions.solutionHtml:
Amikacin

Amikacin is an antibiotic used to prevent or treat a wide variety of bacterial infections. These may include infections of the urinary tract, bones, and joints, lungs (eg. pneumonia), brain, blood, among others. It is also used in hospitalized patients to prevent infections.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 799

questions.stem: A newly joined junior resident in paediatrics started a third-generation IV cephalosporin for gram-negative infection in a 15-day-old baby. The baby developed jaundice after that. Which of the following would be responsible for jaundice?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ceftriaxone

Ceftriaxone is an antibiotic medicine used to treat bacterial infections in your body. It is effective in infections of the brain, lungs, ear, urinary tract, skin and soft tissues, bones and joints, blood and heart. It is also used to prevent infections during surgery.



Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page Number: 1034
